meta.name: openclaw-skill-scanner
meta.description: Security gate for OpenClaw AgentSkills. Scans folder/ClawHub skills with cisco-ai-defense/skill-scanner before installation. Supports manual scans, staged installs, and auto-quarantine of high-risk skills via systemd.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 安装前自动扫描技能安全风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你管理或安装来自公共仓库的技能
copy.tagline_en: Automatically scan skills for security risks before installation.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage or install skills from community repositories.

howto.what: 为OpenClaw AgentSkills增加安全门：在安装新技能前扫描风险，阻止高风险（High/Critical），允许中低风险但警告；同时监控技能目录，自动隔离新出现的高风险技能。
howto.when: 当你尝试通过指定脚本安装技能时，或当技能目录下文件发生更改时自动触发扫描。

say.text: 帮我扫描所有已安装的技能，生成风险报告。
用安全门安装这个文件夹技能，请扫描后再加入。
从ClawHub安装技能 my-tool，并先扫描。

howto.what_en: Adds a security gate to OpenClaw AgentSkills: scans skills before installation, blocking high/critical risks, allowing medium/low with a warning, and automatically monitors the skills directory to quarantine newly detected high-risk skills.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you attempt to install a skill via designated scripts, or automatically when any change occurs in the skills directory.

say_en.text: Scan all my installed skills and generate a risk report.
Install this folder skill with safety gate, scan before adding.
Install the ClawHub skill 'my-tool' with scanning.
